mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_reference_log (knowledge_id, knowledge_title, knowledge_category, source_type, user_id) VALUES (#{knowledgeId}, #{knowledgeTitle}, #{knowledgeCategory}, #{sourceType}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT knowledge_id AS knowledgeId, COALESCE(MAX(knowledge_title), knowledge_id) AS title, MAX(knowledge_category) AS category, COUNT(*) AS referenceCount, MAX(create_time) AS lastReferencedTime FROM knowledge_reference_log WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY knowledge_id ORDER BY referenceCount DESC, lastReferencedTime DESC LIMIT #{limit}
